main_body: multi-story brick townhouse with mansard slate roof
top_band: grey roof deck and slate mansard roof slope from rows 16 to 43, plus copper eave ledge at rows 43-45
evidence: The building shows a distinct 28-row roof structure (rows 16-43) with a lighter eave highlight at row 43, dark eave shadow at rows 46-47, and a detailed 97-row brick facade below with recessed windows and doorway.

style.evidence: The brick pattern is large and repetitive compared to the intricate, fine-grained stone and roof tile textures of the Beodeul references, and dark outlines around the roof and chimney give it a slightly blocky, graphic feel.
